bootstrap_generation: unchanged null-imposed bounded core-five model, original covariance and initial state; full estimator refit in every replicate

criteria.small_nominal_size: Clopper-Pearson 95% interval entirely within [0.03,0.07]; also report Wilson compatibility with 0.05
criteria.moderate_bootstrap_size: Clopper-Pearson 95% interval entirely within [0.03,0.07]; also report Wilson compatibility with 0.05
criteria.small_power: Clopper-Pearson 95% interval for rejection entirely within +/-0.05 of the null-local Gaussian prediction; assessed only if independent small-noise size passes
criteria.moderate_power: descriptive empirical power conditional on size validation; no equality with the null-local approximation at finite amplitude
criteria.selection_scope: one prespecified coefficient only, no general MSTLS-superiority claim
criteria.failures: preserve partial outputs and halt failed study; no silently dropped observations, fits or resamples

geometry.scope: finite-family consistency diagnostic, not a numerical proof of uniform integrability or a joint growing-family limit

smoke.scope: execution checks only; disjoint from all primary seeds
